summary: @servicetitan/document-title preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's preinstall hook (scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs") downloads the Bun runtime from oven-sh/bun GitHub releases into a temp directory, chmod +x's it, and uses execFileSync to invoke it against a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727 KB Bun CJS bundle with obfuscator.io-style transforms (shuffled numeric/string constant arrays, rotating dispatcher function, hex-mangled identifiers) and no source is shipped. setup.mjs itself is also obfuscated with per-call string-array indirection hiding the child_process and https usage. A React document.title library has no functional need for a second language runtime, and pulling Bun specifically to execute an opaque bundled payload at npm install time is an alternate-runtime dropper that bypasses Node-based static analysis. The pattern auto-executes on default `npm install` via the preinstall lifecycle hook.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
